description: Agent Real Estate: submit the seller disclosure with the records it is read against: the disclosure with its form, the day delivered, whether the seller signed it and each question with its id, topic, answer (yes, no, unknown or blank) and text; the topics the form must answer (such as roof, foundation or water intrusion); each defect the seller’s own records show, with its id, topic, the day it was known and its source (a repair, an invoice, an insurance claim, a notice, a prior inspection or other); each finding of the buyer’s inspection with its topic; each amended or late disclosure with its topic and the day delivered; and the day the disclosure was due. The signed report gives the disclosure, the required topics answered, missing and blank, every known defect as disclosed, amended, undisclosed or awaiting an amendment, the inspection findings an answer of no contradicts, and the delivery against the due date with the days late and the topics amended, and counts them, and names a deficient disclosure: a required topic missing from the form and a defect the seller’s own records show was known on or before delivery that the form does not state; then a required question left blank, an answer of no an inspection finding contradicts with no amendment, a defect learned after delivery with no amended disclosure, delivery after the due date and a disclosure the seller did not sign, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No required topics, no defect records, no inspection findings, no delivery date, a defect left off the form with no day it was known, no due date or no word on the signature leaves the disclosure unverified. A defect counts as stated when its topic is answered yes or amended. This reads a seller’s property disclosure: wever_security-disclosure-check reads a vulnerability disclosure policy or security.txt file, wever_ai-disclosure-check reads whether AI involvement in content is disclosed, and wever_insurance-coverage-check reads whether a policy covers an activity, while the disclosure check reads what the seller states about the property and never reads coverage. Verdict realty_disclosure_deficient, realty_disclosure_partial, realty_disclosure_unverified or realty_disclosure_complete. POST /api/realty-disclosure-check. Reads the property records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment, appraisal, listing, brokerage or external write. Agent Real Estate reads supplied property records after the fact and checks them against themselves and against the summary or approval given to the principal: a listing, the title and ownership record, a valuation, the seller disclosure, a lease, an offer or purchase agreement, an inspection report and a closing statement. Beside it, the Tokenized Asset Purchase checks such as wever_tokenized-quote-check read purchases of tokenized asset shares, while a realty check reads conventional property records; the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read policies and coverage, which a realty check never reads; and the payment escrow tools such as wever_agent-escrow-lite hold and release funds, while a realty check holds nothing. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-real-estate-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-real-estate/.
